title: Shower compartments.
officialText:
All shower compartments shall have a minimum of 900 square inches (0.58 m2) of interior cross-
sectional area. Shower compartments shall not be less than 30 inches (762 mm) in minimum dimension measured from the finished
interior dimension of the compartment, exclusive of fixture valves, showerheads, soap dishes, and safety grab bars or rails. Except as
required in Section PC 404, the minimum required area and dimension shall be measured from the finished interior dimension at a
height equal to the top of the threshold and at a point tangent to its centerline and shall be continued to a height not less than 70
inches (1778 mm) above the shower drain outlet.
